title: Spectral analysis of multi-bubble solutions to the Brezis-Nirenberg problem
summary: We investigate weighted spectral limits for separated multi-bubble configurations and refined spectral asymptotics for the Brezis--Nirenberg problem \[ -Δu=u^p+\varepsilon u^q, \quad u>0, \quad\text{in }Ω, \qquad u=0 \quad \text{on }\partialΩ, \] where $Ω$ is a smooth bounded domain in $\mathbb R^N$ with $N\geq3$, $p=(N+2)/(N-2)$, $1\leq q<p$ and $\varepsilon$ is a positive parameter.
